purpose: Research layer for online communities, extremist ecosystems, hate symbols, incidents, migration between platforms and the relationship between online information environments and documented offline events.
epistemic_rule: Community membership, posting activity, association, symbol use or presence in an archive does not by itself establish ideology, criminality or participation in violence. Store identity, ideology, incident and allegation as separate fields.

heatmap_schema.geographic_rule: Use city/country or approximate public geography where appropriate; never publish private addresses or precise locations of individuals.
heatmap_schema.time_rule: Every event should carry a date or bounded period and distinguish original event date from archive/publication date.

platforms.origin: imageboard culture influenced by Japanese anonymous imageboards
platforms.structure: anonymous or pseudonymous boards with board-specific rules and moderators
platforms.important_distinction: 4chan is a platform containing many communities; it should not be treated as one ideology or one organization.
history_leads: major role in internet meme culture
recurrent controversy around harassment, extremist content and anonymity
platforms.source_quality: Use platform records, archived pages, academic work and reputable reporting together; Wikipedia can be a discovery lead rather than sole evidence.

platforms.origin: grew from earlier online communities including CWCki-related forum culture
platforms.structure: forum/community centered on discussion of individuals and internet subcultures
platforms.important_distinction: Map the site and its documented community behavior without treating every user as sharing the same beliefs or conduct.
platforms.source_quality: Use academic studies, court/legal records, reputable journalism and platform/administrator statements; hostile archives are leads, not automatically reliable evidence.

platforms.founders: Steve Huffman, Alexis Ohanian and Aaron Swartz involvement in early development
platforms.structure: large federated-by-community subreddit system with moderators and platform administrators
platforms.important_distinction: Reddit is a platform of many communities and should not be represented as a single political or ideological actor.
platforms.historical_data_value: Older Reddit threads can preserve contemporary attitudes and discourse, but archival completeness is imperfect and platform ranking/search behavior can distort historical sampling.

hate_and_extremism_sources.coverage: white supremacist, neo-Nazi, prison gang and other hate symbols
hate_and_extremism_sources.caution: Symbols are contextual; a symbol alone is insufficient evidence of extremist identity.

hate_and_extremism_sources.coverage: hate, extremism, antisemitism and terrorism incidents
hate and antigovernment groups in the United States
hate_and_extremism_sources.caution: SPLC classifications are an external analytical classification and should be stored as such rather than as an objective legal status.

hate_and_extremism_sources.coverage: reported hate crime incidents and offenses
hate_and_extremism_sources.caution: Reported-crime statistics measure reported incidents under the relevant collection system; they are not a census of all hate activity.

group_record_schema.membership_rule: Record membership estimates only when a source gives a basis. Use ranges and date-stamp them. Do not manufacture numbers from social-media followers.
group_record_schema.legal_status_rule: A designation by a government should be represented with the designating jurisdiction and date. Do not treat an advocacy organization's label as equivalent to a legal designation.

network_dynamics.platform_migration: community -> moderation event -> migration destination -> new community -> archive trail
network_dynamics.symbol_diffusion: symbol -> origin/context -> reinterpretation -> platform adoption -> group adoption -> offline appearance
network_dynamics.harassment_chain: target mention -> thread/post -> amplification -> cross-platform migration -> contact/harassment -> moderation/report -> archive
network_dynamics.violence_chain: ideological content -> mobilization evidence -> threat -> planning evidence -> attack -> investigation -> court record -> historical assessment
network_dynamics.counter_extremism_chain: incident -> monitoring -> platform action -> law-enforcement inquiry -> prosecution/designation where applicable -> archival record
network_dynamics.rule: Do not infer causality merely from temporal sequence. Store evidence connecting stages.

atomwaffen-division.caution: Use law-enforcement records and court documents for criminal allegations.

proud-boys.caution: Do not collapse political identity, group membership and individual criminal liability.

case_schema_for_violence_and_assassinati.critical_rule: Never turn an intelligence-agency allegation, internet theory, anonymous post or mere association into a factual attribution.

epstein_information_ecosystem.graph_rule: Every person/entity connection should specify relationship type and source. A contact, meeting, flight, payment, employment relationship or mention is not by itself evidence of participation in abuse or trafficking.
epstein_information_ecosystem.release_tracking: Track when records were created, when they were sealed/unsealed, when agencies released them and whether later redactions or corrections occurred.

data_sets: Pushshift historical Reddit datasets where legally/publicly available
EU Internet Referral Unit/public Europol reports
research_next.geographic_output: Generate a heatmap from dated public events, not from guesses about where individual users live.
